characters.name: Raju
characters.look: A 32-year-old skinny Indian auto-driver with a mustache, medium brown skin, wearing a khaki auto driver shirt over a white vest.

characters.name: Lakshmi
characters.look: A 28-year-old traditional Indian woman with long black hair tied in a braid, wearing a simple yellow cotton saree with a red border.

characters.name: Srinivas
characters.look: A 50-year-old well-dressed Indian man with grey hair, thick glasses, wearing a crisp light blue buttoned shirt.

episodes.title: రాత్రి వచ్చిన రూపాయి
episodes.summary: Raju finds a large bag of money forgotten in his auto-rickshaw, which his wife Lakshmi begs him to keep for their daughter's urgent school fees. Just as Raju decides whether to keep it or hand it to the police, an elderly passenger appears at their front door demanding his bag.

episodes.title: అతని నిజాయితీ
episodes.summary: Raju and Lakshmi return the bag of money to Srinivas, who came looking for it. Touched by their immense honesty, Srinivas insists on helping pay for their daughter's school fees.

episodes.title: అసలు నిజం
episodes.summary: Srinivas insists on helping pay for Raju's daughter's education as a reward for their honesty, but a sudden arrival at the door interrupts their conversation. This sets up a mysterious new twist for the final part of their journey.

episodes.title: నిజమైన గెలుపు
episodes.summary: Raju, Lakshmi, and Srinivas celebrate the joyful resolution of their daughter's education. Srinivas promises his continuous support, proving that honesty always brings the best rewards.

episodes.title: నిజాయితీ గెలిచింది
episodes.summary: Raju, Lakshmi, and Srinivas celebrate the joyful admission of Raju's daughter to school. The story concludes warmly, proving that honesty is the greatest virtue.

episodes.title: అనుకోని అతిథి
episodes.summary: Srinivas returns to Raju and Lakshmi's house with a mysterious gift to further help their family. As Raju reaches out to open the box, they wonder what surprising new turn their lives are about to take.

episodes.title: అకస్మాత్తుగా అందిన కానుక
episodes.summary: Raju and Lakshmi open the mysterious box brought by Srinivas and are stunned to find an unexpected surprise inside. As they uncover more secrets, a new twist awaits them.

episodes.title: అసలైన రహస్యం
episodes.summary: Raju and Lakshmi hesitate to accept a mysterious gift from Srinivas, but he insists it is for their daughter's future. As Raju finally opens the box, a shocking surprise is revealed inside.
